name: Smart Parking Controller
tagline: Control a smart parking facility with live arrival and departure queues.
brief: Coordinate entrance arrivals, bay allocations, and exit gates in real time.
context: Cars enter, park, and exit asynchronously. Exit requests occupy spots until authorized.
narrative:
Welcome to ParkFlow's Smart Facility Controller interview!

Your task is to control a live multi-tier parking garage. Vehicles arrive with electric, large, VIP, accessible, and reservation requirements.

Unlike static lists, physical movement takes time: exit requests occupy spots until authorized, and drivers have limited patience (carPatienceRemaining). Submit tests your facility controller against hidden traffic scenarios!
objective: Serve the visible shift without hard violations or abandonment, then pass the hidden operations evaluation suite.
learningObjective: Coordinate arrival and departure queues while balancing driver patience, lane capacity, and category safety.
intelligenceExplanation:
Start with an empty rule set. Build your decision flow:
1. Release exit requests when exit gates are open (`hasExitRequest && exitGateAvailable`).
2. Match hard requirements (reserved, accessible, large).
3. Match preferences (VIP, electric).
4. Fall back to standard parking.
hint: Process exit requests first when exit gates are available, then handle reserved and accessible vehicles.
hints: Exit requests still occupy spots until released.
Hard constraints (reserved, accessible, large) must be satisfied.
Check driver patience (carPatienceRemaining) to avoid queue abandonment.

steps.label: Protect reserved, accessible, and large space requirements
steps.hint: Check carReserved, carAccessible, and carLarge first

steps.label: Authorize exit turnover to free up occupied capacity

objectives.label: No vehicle abandons the entrance queue

states.description: Reassess both queues and facility capacity every tick.
